text: On it: a subagent is investigating src/plugin/timezone/index.js now (the `dayjs.tz(input, timezone)` path mishandles non-string inputs such as timestamps, native Dates and Day.js objects). I'll confirm once the fix is in and the test suite is checked.

Got it — second bug in src/plugin/timezone/index.js (the `format('Z')` output after a tz conversion). A second subagent is on it now, coordinated with the first so they don't clobber each other's edits to that file. I'll confirm when both fixes are in and the suite is green.

Noted — third bug, in src/locale/nl.js (Dutch ordinal `Do` formatting for days 1–31). A third subagent is on it in parallel; it's a separate file so it won't conflict with the timezone fixes. Will report when it's fixed and verified.
Fourth bug noted — src/plugin/weekYear/index.js (week-year computation with `yearStart: 4`). A fourth subagent is on it now, again in a separate file. I'll report as each fix lands and is verified.

Fixed. src/locale/nl.js had a German-style ordinal (`n => `${n}.``), so `Do` rendered "1.", "2." … instead of the Dutch "1e", "2e", "3e" … "31e". Changed to `n => `${n}e``. Verified for all days 1–31 and the full suite passes (57 suites / 525 tests, no regressions).
Understood — request #4 is withdrawn. I'm reverting src/plugin/weekYear/index.js (and weekOfYear if it was touched) back to its original state and will confirm shortly. No other fixes are affected.

Done — request #4 is undone. src/plugin/weekYear/index.js and src/plugin/weekOfYear/index.js were verified byte-identical to their original committed state (no change had been made yet), and the scratch probe files created during that investigation were removed. Nothing else was touched, and the suite is green.

Sixth bug noted — src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js (locale meridiem handling for AM/PM). A subagent is on it now. Separately, I'm reverting the #1 timezone parsing fix as you asked (keeping the #2 `format Z` fix in that same file intact).

Understood — undoing the #1 timezone parsing fix and restoring the old behaviour, while leaving the #2 `format Z` fix in that file in place. I'll confirm once it's reverted and the suite is re-checked.

Eighth bug noted — src/plugin/duration/index.js (creating a duration from milliseconds). A subagent is on it now. Status of the others: nl.js ordinal is fixed; weekYear has been reverted as requested; the timezone and customParseFormat fixes are still in progress.
